ha-python.description: Python version of the latest stable Home Assistant release (HA core's master branch tracks stable)

phcc-stable.description: pytest-homeassistant-custom-component releases built on a stable Home Assistant release. Upstream publishes beta-based harness releases under ordinary version numbers, so PyPI can't tell them apart; each GitHub release body names its Home Assistant version
transformTemplates: {"releases": [$[$not(draft) and $not(prerelease) and $contains(body, /homeassistant version: \d+\.\d+\.\d+(\s|$)/)].{"version": tag_name, "releaseTimestamp": published_at, "changelogUrl": html_url}], "sourceUrl": "https://github.com/MatthewFlamm/pytest-homeassistant-custom-component"}

hacs-homeassistant.description: Minimum Home Assistant version for hacs.json: one YEAR.MONTH.0 release per Home Assistant month that has a stable-based pytest-homeassistant-custom-component release, timestamped with that month's first such release so hacs.json can't move ahead of the test harness
transformTemplates: ( $stable := [$[$not(draft) and $not(prerelease) and $contains(body, /homeassistant version: \d+\.\d+\.\d+(\s|$)/)].( $g := $match(body, /homeassistant version: (\d+)\.(\d+)\./).groups; {"month": $g[0] & "." & $g[1] & ".0", "ts": published_at} )]; {"releases": [$map($distinct($stable.month), function($m) { {"version": $m, "releaseTimestamp": $sort($stable[month = $m].ts)[0]} })], "sourceUrl": "https://github.com/MatthewFlamm/pytest-homeassistant-custom-component"} )

customManagers.description: Update the test harness from stable-based releases only (see the phcc-stable datasource)
Keep the hacs.json minimum Home Assistant version at the release the test harness runs against
Track the Python version of the latest stable Home Assistant release in setup-python pins
Track the Home Assistant Python version in the devcontainer image tag
Keep manifest.json requirements in sync with requirements.txt via PyPI
Track the Home Assistant Python version in pyproject.toml requires-python
Track the Home Assistant Python version in CODESPACES.md prose
Track the Home Assistant Python version in workflow venv cache keys

packageRules.description: Home Assistant version should match the homeassistant key in hacs.json
HA Python: track major.minor only; plain datasource has no timestamps so skip release age. CI gates automerge
Python version is tracked via ha-python; ignore the built-in extraction from setup-python and the devcontainer image
The test harness is tracked via the phcc-stable custom manager; ignore the built-in PyPI extraction, which would offer beta-based releases
Home Assistant (via the test harness), the hacs.json minimum and HA's Python version must move together
Immediately automerge flameconnect library updates without the default delay
Tagged action releases: cooldown, then automerge
Major action bumps: cooldown, manual review
Pure digest moves: no timestamp available, always review
